terra.problem: Saying she was running low on everything goes beyond the text, which says she had spent all she had.
The text does not say whether she announced herself or made a scene.
The text says she came through the crowd behind Jesus, not that she reached from the back of the crowd.
Calling her reach quiet adds a detail the text does not give.
The joke imagines Jesus asking a question the text does not give Him.
The text does not say that nobody had spotted the woman.
Saying the crowd is all the disciples see asserts more about their perception than the text gives.
The text does not say the woman had spent twelve years hiding her trouble.
Jesus tells her to go in peace, but the text does not say she went out with peace.
The text does not say the group was quiet.
Saying Jesus clears the house and nobody else gets to watch goes beyond what the text says about putting people outside and taking the parents and His companions in.
The passage gives the words and their meaning but does not identify the language as Aramaic.
The text says the girl got up and walked, but does not say whether she needed help.
The joke imagines Papa Dorin standing in the Bible scene, making him part of the event.
